What are the most common patterns for integrating LLMs with Backend Systems

There are several ways to integrate an LLM with a backend, depending on your architecture and use case.

The two most common real-world approaches are:

  1. Direct API Integration
  2. RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

AI Models and Their
Capabilities.

What is an AI Model?

An AI model is a trained machine learning system designed to perform specific tasks by learning patterns from data. Different models are optimized for different types of input and output, such as text, images, audio, video, or structured data.

Capabilities

Text · Images · audio · video · Structured Data
Model type 1 · /Text

Large Language Models (LLMs).

Purpose
Understand and generate human language.
Examples:
  • GPT-5
  • Claude
  • Gemini
  • LLaMA (Meta)
Capabilities
  • Chatbots
  • Text summarization
  • Content writing
  • Code generation
  • Language translation
Model type 2 · /Images

Image Generation Models(IMGs).

Purpose
Generate images from text.
Examples:
  • DALL·E
  • Stable Diffusion
  • Midjourney
Capabilities
  • Logo generation
  • UI mockups
  • Product designs
  • Digital art
  • Marketing images

What is Tokenization?

Tokenization is the process of breaking text into smaller pieces called tokens that the AI model can understand.

Input
I love programming.
Tokens
["I", " love", " programming", "."]

Tokens

Tokens &
Limitations

What is a Token Limit?
Every AI model has a maximum context window, which is the maximum number of tokens it can process in a single request.
System Prompt 800
Conversation 2200
Your Question 600
Expected Answer 1400
Total 5000
If the model's limit were 4,096 tokens, this request would exceed the limit.
Why Do Token Limits Exist?
Transformers use an attention mechanism, where every token can attend to every other token.
  • More memory is required.
  • More computation is needed.
  • Responses become slower.
  • GPU costs increase significantly.
Approximate Token Counts
A rough rule of thumb for English text is:
1 word 1–2 tokens
100 words ~130 tokens
1 page of text ~500–700 tokens
1,000 words ~1,300 tokens
These are estimates. Different languages and tokenizers produce different counts.
Why Is Token Usage Important?

Every token affects:

  • Cost (many APIs charge per token)
  • Speed (more tokens take longer to process)
  • Memory usage
  • Maximum conversation length

This is why developers try to:

  • Keep prompts concise.
  • Remove unnecessary conversation history.
  • Retrieve only relevant documents in RAG systems.
  • Summarize older messages.

Each command has a paired hook. The command shapes Claude's reasoning. The hook enforces the quality gate deterministically.
